verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs show in-tool conversation surfaces: users "message them in updates" and "@mention them in any conversation" inside monday, alongside items and boards. That evidence is only indirect, though, because it is written about messaging AI agents rather than human teammates. The Slack and Microsoft Teams integrations are external tools and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of team-to-team chat or update threads on items, real-time messaging details, notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: Message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them in any conversation to kick off real work — replies, statuses, and follow-ups included.
